description: Figure 3, titled “Dataset Statistics,” is a bar chart that visually represents the distribution of prompts within the ESSAYBENCH dataset, categorized into two distinct sets: “Open” (denoting Open-Ended sets) and “Cons.” (referring to Constrained sets). The horizontal axis displays these two categories, labeled “Open” and “Cons.” in sequence from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Prompts,” is scaled linearly and ranges from 0 to 728, with tick marks at regular intervals of 100 (0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800). The chart contains two vertical bars: the left bar, corresponding to “Open,” is colored gray and has a height of approximately 600, indicating 600 prompts. The right bar, corresponding to “Cons.,” is colored blue and has a height of approximately 128, indicating 128 prompts. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the categories as labeled on the horizontal axis. There are no additional visual annotations, shading, or emphasis applied to any of the bars.
